title: Rear setback (R2-R15)
text: C3.4.1 Buildings are set back from lot boundaries in accordance with Table 3.4a. Refer Figure 3.4a, b, c. ii. For R2-R25, the stated setback distances may be reduced by half the width of an adjoining pedestrian access way to a maximum reduction of 2m (refer to Figure 3.4d). Table 3.4a Lot boundary setbacks, rear setback: R2 10m; R2.5 7.5m; R5 and above 3m (applicable to R5-R15 only).

replaces.note: R5-R15 rear 6 m -> 3 m; R2 and R2.5 unchanged
rear setbacks by Tables 2a/2b at R17.5-R40 have no draft equivalent
Part C applied Table 3.4a to all boundaries

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Split from the R17.5+ record so the pedestrian access way reduction (a formula) never meets a null table value. R2-R15 lies inside the Chapter 3 R2-R25 reduction band. R5-R15 rear 6 m -> 3 m (register ch3-056). Exception source text keeps the Chapter 2 page so the twin stays identical; the Chapter 3 clause is on p33.

verified.note: R2 10m and R2.5 7.5m are merged across the side and rear columns; the R5-and-above rear cell reads '3m (applicable to R5-R15 only)'; Table 3A (p7) prints 3m spanning R5 to R15. C3.4.1(ii) reads 'For R2-R25'.
